speaker: No. 281
line_text: Look, take my advice, and stay out of there!

speaker: No. 474
line_text: My friend and me were just going to the cathedral to pray for Lady Ashe and Lord Rasler, when some Imperials arrested us! Said we were part of some royalist movement! Can you believe it? They had no proof at all! And my friend, he... (sniff) / What have I done? All I did was pray for Lady Ashe's peaceful repose... / What have I done? All I did was pray for Lady Ashe's peaceful repose...

speaker: No. 278
line_text: Room back there's the corpse pile. That's where they'll throw me when I pass on. You, too. / I wonder why they say "imprisoned for life," when it's for death we're waitin'.

speaker: No. 643
line_text: What did you do to get in here, boy? You don't look none too bright. Throw a stone at some Imperial, or something? / Keeping from dyin' is a full-time business in here. But if you ain't alive, you'll never get out. / Call it what you will, we're an occupied state. What the Empire wants ain't "shared prosperity," or "self-rule." It's a herd of nannas to milk.

speaker: No. 643
line_text: When night comes, you hear the voices... Like demons weeping in the deep...

speaker: No. 502
line_text: You've heard about the lower levels? Sounds like all manner of vile nasties are lurkin' down there... When it gets dark, they get to movin' around... I'd stay out of there, if I were you. / That sound, it's like something from the pits of hell...or worse. / I'm scared... I'll admit it, I'm scared...

speaker: No. 502
line_text: They don't need a reason, them Imperials toss people in here when they feel like it. Criminals, free-thinkers, bad singers...

speaker: No. 281
line_text: Er...annngh... Damn swine...! What's he talking about "spy hunting"? What gives him the right... / That Daguza... Swine thinks his manure's made o' gold.

speaker: No. 691
line_text: Ah, new arrival? Welcome to the famed Nalbina Dungeons, boy. We're all equals here. Stripped of everything by our kind friend the Empire. All we got is our bones, and those'll be theirs soon enough! Har! / You're in with us, which means you're in here for a long, long time. You're lucky. You get to die slow. If they were going to kill you quick, you'd be down in the oubliette. / Don't even think about going back to see the oubliette, boy. They'd as soon toss you in there as look at you.

speaker: Maza
line_text: Shush your babbling! Nobody's asked why you were thrown down here, and nobody cares!

speaker: No. 124
line_text: You Dalmascan, boy? I once fought at this fortress to save the King of Dalmasca. It's true. Seems an age ago, now, down here. / Listen, boy. No matter how hard it gets, don't forget your pride in Dalmasca, and your hatred of the Empire! They're all we got. / Accursed Captain... I hope he's burning in the pits of the underworld...

speaker: No. 395
line_text: Escape? There's plenty of folks down here wanting to do that. Never heard of anyone succeeding, though. / I always heard Nalbina Fortress was impenetrable. Just never thought it worked both ways... / If you're thinking of trying to escape, better stop thinking. The lucky ones get thrown in the oubliette...

speaker: No. 102
line_text: Unh...ahh... W-Water... / W-Why bother giving us this brackish swill... A man can't drink this... / Please, just a taste... Cold, clear water... A taste...

How many times must I say it? / Is that all? / Why not ask Vayne himself? Is he not one of your masters? / We've caught a leader of the insurgence. She is being brought from Rabanastre. / The woman Amalia. / Who could that be? / Such a faithful hound to cling so to a fallen kingdom. / Better than throwing it away. / Throwing it away? As you threw away our homeland? / Who's there? / This the place? / The Mist is flowing through this room. It must be going somewhere. / You! You're no Imperials. Please, you must get me out— / It's against my policy to speak with the dead. Especially when they happen to be kingslayers. / I did not kill him. / Is that so? Glad to hear it. / Please, get me out. For the sake of Dalmasca. / Dalmasca!? / What do you care about Dalmasca!? / Everything that's happened is because of you! / Everyone that's died, every single one! / Even my brother— / You killed my brother! / Quiet!
